messages:
maria: FYI distro vulnerability feeds are flagging a few NVIDIA/CUDA packages with CVEs. Need a quick triage and prioritization for Hosted + Dedicated today. assigning.
ajay: Can you list the CVEs and initial severity? Remote vs local exploit paths?
maria: CVE-2026-1345 (kernel module info leak -> local priv esc), CVE-2026-1382 (userland symlink race affecting driver installer), CVE-2026-1401 (cuDNN OOB read in certain conv kernels). Scores mostly in the 8.x range. Main concern: local escalation on nodes that accept untrusted containers.
jen: Do Dedicated driver images use artifact signing? How does KMS factor into install validation/rotation?
maria: Dedicated uses KMS-backed signatures for our private driver artifacts. Hosted relies on distro packages + checksum verification in the deploy pipeline. Key question: can we rotate signing keys without breaking nodes mid-install? Need to confirm HSM/KMS verification library behavior.
sam: Compatibility note: patched driver seems to break older CUDA 11.3 stacks due to kernel symbol mismatch. We should enumerate CUDA/kernel combos before broad rollout.
maria: good point. quick staging smoke ran with failures.
secops-bot: deploy-scan: 12 staging nodes report driver/library mismatch; 3 containers show cuDNN import errors.
maria: log snippet:
```
E tensorflow: libcudnn.so.8: version `CUDNN_8.2' not found
nvidia-smi: Driver/library version mismatch
```
ajay: Proposed action items:
- immediate hold: pause Hosted autoscale upgrades until fallback verified.
- emergency (high): backport fix for CVE-2026-1345 to driver builds used by control plane & canary nodes.
- medium: schedule cuDNN fix (CVE-2026-1401) for next maintenance after compatibility matrix.
- customer comms: notify Private/on-prem customers with recommended driver tags and kernel compatibility notes.
jen: For KMS/signing: can signing client accept multiple key versions so we can publish with new key while verifying with the old one? @ajay please confirm key policy and workflow.
ajay: KMS supports key versioning. Plan: update signing client to accept both key IDs in verify step so we can rotate keys without breaking verification. I'll make a tiny PR and doc the process.
maria: I'm building a compatibility matrix to run on staging-runner: kernels: 5.4, 5.10, 6.1; CUDA: 11.3, 11.8, 12.0; cuDNN: 8.1, 8.2; runtimes: runc, kata.
sam: add NCCL stress tests and a long-sequence inference run (kv cache + perf) — those exercise different codepaths.
maria: will include NCCL allreduce stress and an end-to-end langchain inference job. reproducible test commands for the team:
```
# driver check
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
# container smoke
docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn8-base nvidia-smi
# cuDNN test
python -c "import torch; print(torch.backends.cudnn.version())"
```
jen: Audit logging: we should capture driver install events, kernel module loads/unloads, and package install operations to central encrypted audit (s3) and fire an org alert if install happens on production nodes. I'll open infra ticket for log collection + alert rule.
maria: TL;DR assignments:
- ajay: update signing client for key version support + docs on rotation. due EOD.
- sam: run full compat matrix on staging runners, attach failing combos and logs. due tomorrow noon.
- jen: infra ticket to stream driver/install/kmod events to central audit and add alert. due tomorrow.
- maria: start emergency backport for CVE-2026-1345 and smoke canary deploy. start now.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for pool-staging-canary at 1827506000
sam: ack, starting matrix now and will post results here.
maria: thanks all. ping me if you hit extra edge cases. :thumbsup:
